newsitem.title: USA: Preferred Employers Q1 net increases.
newsitem.headline: Preferred Employers Q1 net increases.

text.p: For the three months ended March 31, 1997 and 1996
and for the year ended December 31, 1996

NOTE: Preferred Employers Holdings Inc said that its change in focus (from a specialty insurance broker and risk manager to a specialty insurer and risk manager) following its initial public offering in February 1997, dilutes much of the significance of the comparative data as a result of the commencement of operations of its reinsurance subsidiary in the fourth quarter of 1996.

The company said that in accordance with the requirements of Statement of Financial Accounting Standard Number 113 for re-insurance companies, it has deferred approximately $1,904,000 of revenues, $1,857,000 of expenses and $47,000 of pretax profit for the first quarter of 1997 related to the assumption of those policies. For the year ended December 31, 1996, the Company deferred approximately $9,028,000 of revenues, $7,694,000 of expenses and $1,334,000 of pretax profit. These deferred profits will be accreted into income over the claims settlement period (approximately six years).
The company reported pro forma historical results because of its initial public offering.
